metadata.name: CDI Query Generation Test Suite
metadata.description: Example test cases for CDI query generation evaluation

test_cases.clinical_note: A 72-year-old male admitted with pneumonia. Chest X-ray shows bilateral infiltrates. Patient is hypoxic requiring 4L O2. Blood cultures pending. Started on ceftriaxone and azithromycin.
test_cases.query_context: Documentation does not specify if pneumonia is community-acquired or healthcare-associated

test_cases.clinical_note: A 65-year-old female with altered mental status. Labs show sodium 118 mEq/L. Patient is euvolemic. CT head negative. Urine osmolality elevated.
test_cases.query_context: Etiology of hyponatremia not documented for accurate coding

test_cases.clinical_note: A 58-year-old male with GI bleed. Hemoglobin dropped from 12 to 8. EGD shows gastric ulcer with visible vessel. Patient received 2 units PRBCs.
test_cases.query_context: Acuity and severity of anemia not documented

test_cases.clinical_note: A 70-year-old male with heart failure exacerbation. BNP 2500, ejection fraction 30%. Patient has 3+ pitting edema and crackles. IV furosemide started.
test_cases.query_context: Type of heart failure (systolic vs diastolic) and acuity need clarification

test_cases.clinical_note: A 80-year-old female with sepsis from UTI. Blood pressure 85/50 despite 2L fluid resuscitation. Lactate 4.2. Started on norepinephrine.
test_cases.query_context: Documentation should clarify if this meets criteria for septic shock
